column2: is constituted are hereby declared to be—

column3: to  give  temporary  residential  facilities  to  patients
from  various  areas  of  Sri  Lanka  suffering  from

dreadful  non  –  communicable  diseases 
to 
the
Karapitiya Hospital for treatment;

to  provide  assistance  and  support 
through 
the
implementation of programmes for the advantage
of  the  differently  abled  and  children  with  special
needs;
to  operate  a  library  for  making  available  library
facilities for the mental comfort of residents;
to provide the residents with a meal prepared in a
safe manner and according to proper standard free
of charge;
to  provide  each  patient  facilities  separately,  such
as  fridges  necessary  to  properly  store  medicines
etc,  that  should  be  administered  daily  to  patients
and operating a support service to give each patient
the  prescribed  doses  of  medicine  at  the  specified
time;

to 
provide 
free 
accommodation 
facilities 
to
relatives,  friends  or  acquaintances  accompanying
patients  and  providing  them  with  meals  free  of
